Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other
vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the
type and force of the impact, and the presenting shoulder complaints fit well with that
mechanism. Over the course of eight visits, the patient received conservative
management including physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise
instruction. Course of care ran somewhat longer than is typical for this injury
pattern, which we attribute in part to a pre-existing shoulder condition treated
within the past two years that continues to contribute to current symptoms. On
examination, several findings support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including
limited active elevation and tenderness along the roattor cuff insertion. Other tests,
including neurovascular screening and strength testing in the distal extremity,
returned normal results. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicated
or repeaetd charges for the same services. Ongoing improvement is expected with
continued home program adherence, with reassessment planned if symptoms do not
continue to resolve.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
